evidence.t: Trail: Parker / Evie Lake Trail, 4.7 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 38 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.88516, -123.06115, pull off on Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy) (paved road). Map links below.
Walk 1.7 km to the start. Walk: the Parker / Evie Lake Trail stretch, 4.7 km one way. About 93 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-49, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
